review.label: NON_EQUIVALENT
review.rationale: The overlay replaces the condition `existing.request_digest != request_digest` with the literal `False`, which permanently disables the idempotency mismatch check. In the original code, when an existing commitment is found and its stored request digest differs from the incoming request digest, a `GlhsInvariantError('commitment_idempotency_reuse_mismatch')` is raised. After the mutation, that error is never raised regardless of digest mismatch; instead, the function always proceeds to `return cast(GlhsClinicalCommitmentTransition, existing)`. This produces an observable behavioral difference: a caller submitting a reused commitment ID with a different request payload will receive a successful return value instead of an exception.
